title: Preserve exact Git-path query case and whitespace across hosts
body:
Path overlap queries currently use host-dependent fnmatch case rules and strip query whitespace. On Windows, a glob can match a different Git path case; a space-only query silently disappears. Use case-sensitive fnmatchcase and retain literal query spaces. Reject a truly empty pattern before any search. The CLI help states these rules.

Validation: all 100 overlap-consumer tests pass on Python 3.12; the 5 new tests pass under `-O`. Cases cover Windows-style normalization, leading/trailing and space-only queries, multiple glob/substring patterns and early rejection without local or remote calls. Native Windows execution was not run. `git diff --check` passes.

Fresh main/priorities and live PR/Discussion overlap checked. Other PRs in this sequence edit distinct parts of the overlap tool; this change is independent. Hosted CI is pending.

Base: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. Verified head: `0c084e2d1ff26ce3f0098b4867f8d5427a47e052`.
